name: Garmin HUD
description: Replaces standard stat cells with Garmin-style rolling graphs colored by live Biketerra zones. Values come from the biketerra-ride broadcast (ego) at feed rate (~2Hz, 60s window), with DOM fallback when the feed is quiet.
